import sys 

input = sys.stdin.readline

t = int(input())

for _ in range(t):
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    
    a.sort(reverse=True)
    
    pref = [0] * (3 * n + 1)
    for i in range (3 * n):
        pref[i + 1] = pref[i] + a[i]
        
        ans= 0
        
    for p in range(n + 1):
        lo = 0
        hi = n - p
        while lo < hi:
            q= (lo + hi) // 2
            j = p + 2 * q
            k = 3 * n - 2 * p - q
            
            cur =  (6 * pref[p] + 4 * (pref[j] - pref[p]) +  3 * (pref[k] -pref[j]))
        
            nq = q + 1
            j2 = p + 2 * nq
            k2 = 3 * n -2 * p - nq
        
        
            nxt = (6 * pref[p] + 4 * (pref[j2] - pref[p]) + 3 * (pref[k2] - pref[j2]))
        
        
            if nxt > cur:
                lo = q + 1
            else:
                hi = q
        q = lo
        j = p + 2 * q 
        k = 3 * n - 2 * p - q 
            
            
        value = ( 6 * pref[p] + 4 * (pref[j] - pref[p]) + 3 * (pref[k] - pref[j]))
        ans = max(ans, value)
            
    print(ans)
